news.summary: Key TakeawaysArgus cut its Reddit price target to $150 from $225 and kept its Buy rating, a target 49% above today’s price. Reddit’s stock has sunk since its third-quarter report, when management warned that search traffic from Alphabet’s Google is falling fast and daily users could drop.
news.title: Argus’s $150 Target Says Reddit’s Selloff Went Too Far
news.title_zh: Argus 的 $150 目標價稱 Reddit 的拋售過度
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Argus 將 Reddit 目標價從 $225 下調至 $150 並維持買入評級，目標價比當前價格高出 49%。自第三季財報以來，Reddit 股價下跌，管理層警告來自 Alphabet 旗下 Google 的搜尋流量正快速下降，每日用戶可能減少。

news.summary: Three trusts tied to Larry Page filed to sell again, right as Alphabet struggles to hold $300 after a brutal earnings drop. Does a preset schedule matter, or is something bigger weighing on the stock?
news.title: Google’s Co-Founder Is Cashing Out Another $148 Million
news.title_zh: Google 聯合創始人再次套現 $148 Million
news.summary_zh: 與 Larry Page 相關的三個信託再次申請出售，正值 Alphabet 在慘烈的財報下跌後難以守住 $300。這是預設時間表使然，還是有更大因素壓制股價？

news.summary: Alphabet just doubled Google Cloud sales and grew revenue 25%, yet the stock sank nearly 17% in a month. One model maps three very different outcomes for a $1,000 stake, and the gap between best and worst case is striking.
news.title: If You Invest $1,000 in Alphabet Today, Here’s What It Could Be Worth by 2030
news.title_zh: 若您今天在 Alphabet 投資 $1,000，到 2030 可能值多少
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 的 Google Cloud 銷售額剛翻倍，營收增長 25%，股價卻在一個月內下跌近 17%。一個模型為 $1,000 持倉繪製了三種截然不同的結果，最佳與最差情況之間的差距驚人。

news.summary: Advocate General Juliane Kokott has advised the Court of Justice of the EU to set aside the General Court's September 2024 judgment and return the case for a new ruling.
news.title: Google faces renewed challenge over $1.66bn advertising fine
news.title_zh: Google 面臨 $1.66bn 廣告罰款的新挑戰
news.summary_zh: 歐盟法院總檢察長 Juliane Kokott 建議歐盟法院撤銷普通法院的 September 2024 判決，並將案件發回重審。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysBroadcom stock is up 25% in the past week as chip stocks rebounded and Nvidia’s CEO exit sent investors to rivals like AMD. Nvidia’s turmoil gives AI buyers a reason to want a second supplier, and Broadcom helps design and supplies Alphabet’s custom TPU chips.
news.title: Broadcom Just Gained 25% in a Week: Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.title_zh: Broadcom 一周內漲幅達 25%：獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Broadcom 股價在過去一周上漲 25%，因晶片股反彈且 Nvidia CEO 卸任導致投資者轉向 AMD 等競爭對手。Nvidia 的動盪讓 AI 買家有理由尋求第二供應商，而 Broadcom 協助設計並供應 Alphabet 的客製化 TPU 晶片。

news.summary: The search giant's turning its AI chips into hardware it sells. Is the stock a buy around 28% below its peak?
news.title: Should You Buy Alphabet Stock Now That Google Will Let Customers Run Its AI Chips in Their Own Data Centers?
news.title_zh: 現在 Google 讓客戶在自家資料中心運行其 AI 晶片，你應該買入 Alphabet 股票嗎？
news.summary_zh: 搜尋巨頭將其 AI 晶片轉型為可銷售的硬體。股價距離高點約 28% 時是否值得買入？

news.summary: Trouble at Nvidia could create an opening for Alphabet's chip business.
news.title: Why Alphabet Stock Was Moving Higher Today
news.title_zh: 為何 Alphabet 股價今日上漲
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 的麻煩可能為 Alphabet 的晶片業務創造機會。

news.summary: When NVIDIA's CEO walked out the door with no successor in place, one cloud giant's stock jumped while its rivals barely moved. The reason traces back to a chip strategy only two companies can claim, and a test arrives November 17.
news.title: Alphabet Climbs 3% as NVIDIA’s Leadership Shake-Up Puts Google’s AI Chips in the Spotlight; Microsoft Gains 2%, Amazon Ticks Up
news.title_zh: Alphabet 上漲 3%，NVIDIA 領導層變動使 Google AI 晶片成焦點；Microsoft 漲 2%，Amazon 小幅上揚
news.summary_zh: 當 NVIDIA CEO 在無繼任者情況下離職，一家雲端巨頭股價大漲而競爭對手幾乎不動。原因可追溯到僅有兩家公司能聲稱擁有的晶片策略，且一項考驗將於 November 17 到來。

news.summary: Apple trades above every analyst target on the Street, yet one investor keeps buying after each earnings report. Why he passes on cheaper-looking Microsoft and Alphabet, and what memory costs could do to the thesis, makes for a contrarian case.
news.title: Wall Street Models Lag Structural Reality, Prompting Me To Add an ‘Overvalued’ Apple
news.title_zh: 華爾街模型落後於結構性現實，促使我增持「高估」的蘋果
news.summary_zh: 蘋果股價高於華爾街所有分析師目標價，但一位投資人在每次財報後持續買入。為何他放棄看似更便宜的微軟和Alphabet，以及記憶體成本可能對投資論點造成的影響，構成了一個反向投資案例。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysBerkshire Hathaway’s 13F for the quarter ended Sept. 30 is due Monday, and its last one showed Apple, American Express, Coca-Cola, Alphabet and Bank of America as its five biggest positions.
news.title: What to Watch When Berkshire Hathaway Files Its 13F on Monday
news.title_zh: 伯克希爾·哈撒韋週一提交 13F 時應關注什麼
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：伯克希爾·哈撒韋截至 Sept. 30 季度的 13F 將於週一公布，其上一份報告顯示蘋果、美國運通、可口可樂、Alphabet 和美國銀行為其前五大持倉。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysArm CEO Rene Haas warned that “the rest of the world is ready and willing” to build data centers if the US holds back, after local voters rejected 40 of 41 data center ballot measures by Scott Galloway’s count. Long-running AI agents don’t need to sit near their users, so the build-out can move abroad, and Alphabet’s Google just committed $15 billion to Malaysia, much of it for data center campuses.
news.title: Arm CEO: The World Is “Ready and Willing” to Build the Data Centers America Blocks
news.title_zh: Arm執行長：世界已「準備好並願意」建設美國阻擋的數據中心
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Arm執行長Rene Haas警告稱，若美國阻撓，根據Scott Galloway的統計，當地選民否決了 40 項 41 數據中心投票提案，「世界其他地方已準備好並願意」建設數據中心。長期運行的AI代理不需靠近用戶，因此建設可移往海外，Alphabet旗下Google剛承諾投入 $15 billion 於馬來西亞，其中大部分用於數據中心園區。

news.title: Microsoft Makes Some Progress on Outlook Outage
news.summary: Microsoft Corp. is struggling to restore access to its flagship software and end an outage that has paralyzed government offices, traders and businesses globally. news.title: Lutnick Under Fire as Bessent Blames Commerce for Nvidia Crisis
news.summary: Denver Riggleman, CEO of RIIG Technology, said that it is 'mind boggling' that anyone would defend Jensen Huang's actions as he faces the personal, political and legal fallout from his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Riggleman, who served in Congress as a representative from Virginia, said that lawmakers who want to get real answers from both Jensen Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick should call on intelligence experts to advise them on their line of questioning. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) SVP Sells $842,912.64 in Stock
news.summary: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL - Get Free Report) SVP Jennifer Newstead sold 2,399 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, November 10th. The stock was sold at an average price of $351.36, for a total transaction of $842,912.64. Following the completion of the transaction, the senior vice president directly owned 27,598 shares of the company's stock, valued at approximately $9,696,833.28. The trade was a 8.00% decrease in their ownership of the stock. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this hyperlink.

news.title: Where companies should place their AI bets
news.summary: After several years of pushing organizationwide AI adoption, companies are now confronting the cost. As boardroom conversations shift to return on investment, business leaders are taking a harder look at which AI bets to fund and scale. To understand what questions executives should be asking ahead of AI investments, Meredith Mazzilli, The Information’s finance editor, spoke with three experts approaching AI from different perspectives. Karen Young, chair of the U.S. board of partners and U.S. sales leader, PwC Mimi Carsley, chief financial officer and treasurer, Jack Henry & Associates Heidi Rhodes, global director, enterprise GTM customer success and sales enablement, Meta Platforms Resetting Priorities At Meta Platforms, Mark Zuckerberg has taken an experimentation-first approach, making AI adoption a priority across the company. “He basically said, ‘This is going to be the year that everyone is going to adopt AI.’ We told our employees, ‘Figure out what works and go fail,’” recalled Heidi Rhodes. news.summary: Key TakeawaysBroadcom fell 7% today after Rothschild & Co Redburn cut it to Neutral and lowered its target to $398 from $595. Redburn says Broadcom’s AI growth depends on Anthropic and OpenAI paying their own way, and doesn’t expect that quickly.

news.summary: Wall Street analysts are unanimous on Broadcom, yet the loudest skeptics sit on CNBC, and the stock has dropped after beating earnings before. Financing risks, supply limits, and a split in institutional money complicate the bullish picture.

news.title: Mosaic Raises Funds for Robotic Surgery
news.summary: Anthropic said on Tuesday that it has launched its roadshow, a 7 to 10 day period ahead of an IPO in which a company pitches prospective institutional investors like mutual funds, pension funds and hedge funds. Interestingly, the tentative valuation the Claude-maker set, of between $1.26 trillion to $1.4 trillion, was slightly lower than what investors initially expected. (And, it’s also around the $1.25 trillion valuation that OpenAI recently raised $11 billion at, despite the fact that Anthropic generates more revenue. That’s likely for several reasons, including that Anthropic likely wants its stock to have some wiggle room to trade up after its IPO.) Meanwhile, the largest pure-play robotics company in the world by revenue and market cap is Intuitive Surgical , which makes the da Vinci Surgical System , a multi-armed contraption that human surgeons use on a remote-control basis to perform a variety of operations. But da Vinci was first unveiled over 25 years ago, and a new generation of robotics companies is aiming to further automate surgery by harnessing the latest advances in AI. news.title_zh: Marvell 今年仍上漲 81%。MRVL 股票能在 2029 前達到 $300 嗎？
news.summary_zh: 晶片股的艱難秋季並未抹去該板塊今年最突出的漲幅之一。Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL) 股價今年迄今 (YTD) 上漲 81%，至下午交易時段的 $153.93。該價格包含較前收盤價下跌 6%，因廣泛的半導體拋售衝擊 Marvell 及其同業。科技股 […]

news.summary: Marvell's shares have lost nearly 40% in a month, yet its business is accelerating and a quiet Google deal could rewrite the numbers. So why is the market running the other way, and who is about to be proven wrong?
news.title: Marvell Stock Could Have a Bigger AI Opportunity Than Investors Realize
news.title_zh: Marvell 股票可能擁有比投資人認知更大的 AI 機會
news.summary_zh: Marvell 股價在一個月內下跌近 40%，但其業務正在加速，且一項低調的 Google 交易可能重寫數字。那麼為何市場卻朝相反方向運作，誰即將被證明錯誤？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum stock is up 56% in 2026, well ahead of rival Coherent, but it’s nearly half off its October high after Marvell’s all-stock deal and an AI chip selloff. Lumentum’s business drove the run: September-quarter revenue rose 136.
news.title: Lumentum Is Up 56% in 2026, but Marvell Now Sets Its Price. Take Profits, or Buy More?
news.title_zh: Lumentum 在 2026 上漲 56%，但 Marvell 現在決定其價格。獲利了結，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Lumentum 股價在 2026 上漲 56%，遠超競爭對手 Coherent，但在 Marvell 的全股票交易和 AI 晶片拋售潮後，股價較十月高點已近乎腰斬。Lumentum 的業務推動了漲勢：九月季營收上升 136。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology stock soared 23% in a week, and Lumentum, which Marvell agreed to buy, rose almost as much. CoreWeave’s beat-and-raise revived the AI trade, though Lumentum still trades below the deal’s value.
news.title: Marvell Soars 23%, Lumentum Up 23% in a Week. Jim Cramer Says It’s Not “a Broken Stock”
news.title_zh: Marvell 飆升 23%，Lumentum 一週上漲 23%。Jim Cramer 表示這不是「一檔破股」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Marvell Technology 股價一週飆升 23%，而 Marvell 同意收購的 Lumentum 漲幅幾乎持平。CoreWeave 的超預期表現與上調展望重燃 AI 題材，儘管 Lumentum 仍低於交易估值交易。

news.summary: Lumentum's revenue is more than doubling, yet its stock now moves with Marvell's shares and a regulatory clock that runs into 2028. Who actually profits from the discount, and what could erase it?
news.title: Lumentum Trades Below Marvell’s Buyout Offer. Is the Gap a Bargain?
news.title_zh: Lumentum 股價低於 Marvell 收購要價。這個缺口是便宜貨嗎？
news.summary_zh: Lumentum 營收翻倍以上，但其股價現在隨 Marvell 股價和監管時限移動，時限延至 2028。誰真正從折價中獲利？什麼可能抹平這個折價？

news.summary: Marvell's forward P/E sits well below AMD's, but its revenue jump and rising margins raise a tougher question about which chip stock can hold up through 2027.
news.title: Advanced Micro Devices vs. Marvell Technology: Which Artificial Intelligence Stock Is a Better Buy Going into 2027?
news.title_zh: Advanced Micro Devices 對比 Marvell Technology：進入 2027 哪檔人工智慧股票是更好的買入？
news.summary_zh: Marvell 的遠期市盈率遠低於 AMD，但其營收躍升和利潤率上升提出了更棘手的問題：哪檔晶片股能在 2027 期間撐住。

news.summary: There has been no shortage of news these last few weeks coming out of the memory and optics sectors in regards to AI investing. Eric Bleeker and Austin Smith are here to break down just a few of them, including Marvell's purchase of Lumentum in a huge $80 billion deal. Marvell has enjoyed a nice surge since the acquisition - one of the largest in tech history - and the company has a history of needing to reshape its brand and business which could be helpful. The two also shared some updates in regards to companies including Micron, Semtech and Alphabet, as well as what investors can expect from them as we move into 2027.
news.title: Marvell Acquires Lumentum in Blockbuster $80 Billion Deal
news.title_zh: Marvell 以超級 $80 Billion 交易收購 Lumentum
news.summary_zh: 過去幾週來自記憶體和光學產業關於 AI 投資的消息不絕於耳。Eric Bleeker 和 Austin Smith 在這裡為您分析其中幾項，包括 Marvell 以巨額 $80 billion 交易收購 Lumentum。自收購以來，Marvell 享受了不錯的漲勢——這是科技史上最大筆交易之一——且該公司有重塑品牌和業務的歷史，這可能會有所幫助。兩人還分享了關於 Micron、Semtech 和 Alphabet 等公司的最新動態，以及隨著我們進入 2027，投資人可以從他們身上期待什麼。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron shares jumped 10% today, along with SK hynix, Sandisk, Nebius and Marvell, after CoreWeave raised its 2026 revenue outlook. CoreWeave’s $132.
news.title: Micron Soars 10%, SK hynix Up 9% as CoreWeave Raises Outlook on “A Breakout Quarter”
news.title_zh: Micron 飆漲 10%，SK hynix 上漲 9%，因 CoreWeave 上調展望稱「突破性季度」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Micron 股價今日跳漲 10%，連同 SK hynix、Sandisk、Nebius 和 Marvell，因 CoreWeave 上調其 2026 營收展望。CoreWeave 的 $132。

news.summary: After a brutal month that wiped roughly 40% off some of the biggest names in AI silicon, one cloud provider's earnings and a quiet funding shift just sparked a rebound. Can it survive the Fed and the next AI financing scare?
news.title: Marvell and Intel Rally 7% as CoreWeave’s Results Reignite the AI Chip Trade; Taiwan Semiconductor Climbs 4%
news.title_zh: Marvell 和 Intel 漲 7%，CoreWeave 財報重燃 AI 晶片交易；台積電漲 4%
news.summary_zh: 經過慘烈一月，抹去 AI 晶片巨頭約 40% 市值，一家雲端供應商的財報與安靜的資金轉移引發反彈。能否熬過聯準會與下一波 AI 融資恐慌？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares rose 5% today after CoreWeave beat on revenue and raised its 2026 outlook, lifting Lumentum, Marvell, Credo and Astera Labs too. CoreWeave’s faster, better-funded buildout points to more demand for the optics Coherent makes.
news.title: Coherent Rises 5% as CoreWeave’s Beat-and-Raise Revives the AI Trade: “A Breakout Quarter”
news.title_zh: Coherent 上漲 5%，CoreWeave 的超預期並上調展望重燃 AI 題材：「突破性季度」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Coherent 股價今日上漲 5%，因 CoreWeave 營收超預期並上調其 2026 展望，帶動 Lumentum、Marvell、Credo 和 Astera Labs 同步上揚。CoreWeave 較快、資金更充足的建設指向對 Coherent 所製造光學元件的更多需求。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysCredo Technology stock fell 14% in the past week after Democrats’ midterm sweep hit AI data center stocks, and Lumentum and Marvell fell with it. Credo had no bad news of its own, and its guidance for the current quarter still stands.
news.title: Credo and Lumentum Sink 14% in a Week as Democrats’ Sweep Hits AI Data Centers
news.title_zh: 隨著民主黨大勝衝擊 AI 資料中心，Credo 和 Lumentum 一週內下跌 14%
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Credo Technology 股價在過去一週下跌 14%，原因是民主黨在期中選舉大勝衝擊了 AI 資料中心股票，Lumentum 和 Marvell 也隨之下跌。Credo 本身沒有壞消息，其本季財測依然有效。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysLumentum fell 11% in the past week as the AI hardware selloff hit Marvell, whose all-stock offer drives its price, and it lagged Coherent’s rebound. September-quarter revenue rose 136.
news.title: Lumentum Sinks 11% in a Week as Marvell’s All-Stock Offer Shrinks: “Our Demand Couldn’t Be Stronger”
news.title_zh: Lumentum 一週下跌 11%，因 Marvell 全股票收購要約縮水：「我們的需求再強烈也不過分」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Lumentum 過去一週下跌 11%，AI 硬體拋售潮衝擊 Marvell，其全股票收購要約決定 Lumentum 股價，且 Lumentum 落後於 Coherent 的反彈。九月季營收上升 136。

news.title: Cerebras CEO: AI Infrastructure Opportunity Is Expanding
news.summary: Cerebras is raising its outlook after third-quarter revenue jumped 55%, fueled by cloud and services sales that more than tripled. CEO Andrew Feldman discusses growing demand and pricing power for fast AI inference, new hyperscaler relationships with Microsoft, AWS and Oracle, and what Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation could mean for the competitive landscape. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Cerebras 執行長：AI 基礎建設機會正在擴大
news.summary_zh: Cerebras 在第三季營收跳增 55% 後上調展望，雲端與服務銷售增長超過三倍。執行長 Andrew Feldman 討論快速 AI 推理的需求增長與定價權、與 Microsoft、AWS 和 Oracle 的新超大規模客戶關係，以及 Nvidia 執行長 Jensen Huang 辭職可能對競爭格局意味著什麼。他接受 Ed Ludlow 於「Bloomberg Tech」專訪。（來源：Bloomberg）

news.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy rose 13% in the past week, with Vertiv and Oracle, after CoreWeave and Constellation Energy raised their 2026 guidance. Bloom had no news of its own, and with its orders and rising estimates intact, the bounce looks like it has further to go.
news.title: Bloom Energy Soars 13%, Vertiv Up 14% in a Week as Data-Center Fears Ease
news.title_zh: Bloom Energy 飆升 13%，Vertiv 上漲 14%，一週內數據中心憂慮緩解

news.title: Cerebras Soars on Sales; Cisco Down on Expectations Miss | Stock Movers
news.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Shares of Cerebras Systems (CBRS) soared ahead of the US market open after the chipmaker gave a sales guidance well above estimates, while unveiling new deals with Oracle and Microsoft. A key investor concern is a rollout delay in the firm’s contract with OpenAI. - Shares of Cisco Systems (CSCO) declined in the early session after the networking gear maker reported a 21% rise in product orders in fiscal 1Q, missing expectations and marking a slowdown from the previous period. - Shares of Applied Materials (AMAT) inched higher after the company reported fourth-quarter results that beat expectations and gave an outlook for adjusted first-quarter earnings that is stronger than expected. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Cerebras 因銷售利好飆升；Cisco 因未達預期下跌 | 股價動向
news.summary_zh: 本期《股價動向》：- Cerebras Systems (CBRS) 股價在美股開盤前飆升，因該晶片製造商給出的銷售指引遠超預期，同時宣布與 Oracle 和 Microsoft 達成新協議。投資者關注的焦點在於該公司與 OpenAI 合約的推出延遲。- Cisco Systems (CSCO) 股價早盤下跌，因這家網路設備製造商報告財年 1Q 產品訂單增長 21%，未達預期，且較前一期放緩。- Applied Materials (AMAT) 股價小幅上漲，因公司第四季業績超預期，並給出比預期更強的調整後第一季盈利展望。(來源：彭博社)

news.summary: Oracle sits on a record contracted backlog while burning cash at a pace that has forced stock sales and new debt. Two numbers on its financial statements tell opposite stories, and only one can decide whether this slide is a bargain or a trap.
news.title: Is There Hope for Oracle After Plummeting 35% This Year? ‘Yes’ Says One Analyst Predicting 210% Gains From Here
news.title_zh: Oracle 今年暴跌 35% 後還有希望嗎？一位分析師預測將從這裡獲得 210% 漲幅，回答「有」
news.summary_zh: Oracle 擁有創紀錄的合約訂單積壓，卻以迫使其出售股票和新增債務的速度燃燒現金。其財報上的兩個數字講述了截然不同的故事，只有一個能決定這波下跌是便宜貨還是陷阱。

news.summary: Microsoft just walked away from an Oracle GPU deal, and Oracle insists demand is booming. One lapsed contract may hold the pricing evidence Michael Burry's depreciation warning has lacked, and the next earnings reports could settle who is right.
news.title: Michael Burry Warned About This AI Risk a Year Ago. Microsoft May Have Just Proved His Point
news.title_zh: Michael Burry 一年前警告此 AI 風險。Microsoft 可能剛證明了他的觀點
news.summary_zh: Microsoft 剛退出一項 Oracle GPU 交易，而 Oracle 堅稱需求強勁。一份失效的合約可能掌握 Michael Burry 折舊警告所缺乏的定價證據，下一份財報可能會揭曉誰是對的。

items.title: Cerebras CEO: AI Infrastructure Opportunity Is Expanding
items.summary: Cerebras is raising its outlook after third-quarter revenue jumped 55%, fueled by cloud and services sales that more than tripled. CEO Andrew Feldman discusses growing demand and pricing power for fast AI inference, new hyperscaler relationships with Microsoft, AWS and Oracle, and what Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation could mean for the competitive landscape. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Cerebras Soars on Sales; Cisco Down on Expectations Miss | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Shares of Cerebras Systems (CBRS) soared ahead of the US market open after the chipmaker gave a sales guidance well above estimates, while unveiling new deals with Oracle and Microsoft. A key investor concern is a rollout delay in the firm’s contract with OpenAI. - Shares of Cisco Systems (CSCO) declined in the early session after the networking gear maker reported a 21% rise in product orders in fiscal 1Q, missing expectations and marking a slowdown from the previous period. - Shares of Applied Materials (AMAT) inched higher after the company reported fourth-quarter results that beat expectations and gave an outlook for adjusted first-quarter earnings that is stronger than expected. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO amid scandal
news.title_zh: 黃仁勳因醜聞辭去Nvidia CEO職務

news.summary: After a brutal month, AI data center stocks are snapping back on a single piece of financing news from CoreWeave. But Applied Digital's debt load and a hawkish Fed could still decide whether this bounce holds.
news.title: Applied Digital Rallies 8% as CoreWeave’s Results Revive the AI Data Center Trade; Cipher Digital Jumps 10%, IREN Surges 9%
news.title_zh: Applied Digital 反彈 8%，隨著 CoreWeave 財報重振 AI 資料中心交易；Cipher Digital 飆升 10%，IREN 暴漲 9%
news.summary_zh: 經過慘烈的一個月後，AI 資料中心股票因 CoreWeave 的一則融資消息而反彈。但 Applied Digital 的債務負擔和鷹派聯準會仍可能決定這波反彈能否持續。

news.summary: Iren's 70% crash does not align with its strengthening fundamentals. The mismatch won't provide an asymmetric opportunity forever.
news.title: 1 Unstoppable AI Stock to Buy Hand Over Fist Before the Next Leg Higher
news.title_zh: 1 無法阻擋的 AI 股票，在下一波上漲前大量買入
news.summary_zh: Iren 的 70% 暴跌與其增強的基本面不符。這種錯配不會永遠提供非對稱機會。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysNebius stock fell 12% in a week as the midterms and a Microsoft report hit the neoclouds, IREN and CoreWeave included. Microsoft’s tighter oversight of Nebius’s projects is a bigger risk than the election, though Nebius carried a sliver of CoreWeave’s debt at midyear.
news.title: Nebius Sinks 12% in a Week: “Not All of These Companies Are Going to Make It”
news.title_zh: Nebius一週內暴跌 12%：「並非所有這些公司都能生存下來」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Nebius股價一週內下跌 12%，因中期選舉和微軟報告打擊新雲端股，包括IREN和CoreWeave。微軟對Nebius項目更嚴格的監督比大選風險更大，儘管Nebius在年中時持有CoreWeave一小部分債務。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysCipher Digital fell 20% in the week to Nov. 10, alongside CleanSpark and IREN, after Texas elected a governor who wants to pause new data centers.
news.title: “That Stops When I’m Governor”: Cipher Digital and CleanSpark Sink Nearly 20% in a Week
news.title_zh: 「當我當選州長時這就會停止」：Cipher Digital 和 CleanSpark 一週內下跌近 20%

news.summary: The company’s revenue backlog stood at approximately $132.5 billion as of the end of the quarter, up from approximately $104.2 billion as of June 30.

news.summary: A delayed Microsoft buildout and a $6 billion funding hole have analysts slashing IREN targets, and a hot inflation print is making it worse. Why are two rival miners holding up better, and what separates their models?
news.title: IREN Sinks 10% as Analyst Target Cuts Pile Up After Microsoft Delay; Cipher Digital Falls 6%, TeraWulf Slides 2%
news.title_zh: IREN暴跌 10%，因微軟延遲導致分析師目標價下調累積；Cipher Digital下跌 6%，TeraWulf下滑 2%
news.summary_zh: 微軟建設延遲和 $6 billion 資金缺口導致分析師大幅下調IREN目標價，熱門通脹數據讓情況更糟。為何兩家競爭對手礦商表現較好，其模式有何不同？

news.summary: Key TakeawaysJPMorgan cut its IREN price target to $55 from $65 on Monday and kept its Overweight rating, leaving 148% upside after a 68% drop in a year. IREN pushed its $4 billion revenue run-rate target into early 2027 after Microsoft asked for a network upgrade, and $6 billion of this fiscal year’s build still needs funding.
news.title: JPMorgan Cut Its IREN Target to $55. It Still Sees 148% Upside
news.title_zh: JPMorgan 將 IREN 目標價下調至 $55。仍看好 148% 上漲空間
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要JPMorgan 週一將 IREN 目標價從 $65 下調至 $55，維持增持評級，在一年下跌 68% 後仍留有 148% 上漲空間。IREN 在微軟要求網路升級後，將其 $4 billion 營收運行率目標推遲至 2027 初，且本財年建設的 $6 billion 仍需資金。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft is winding down a 2023 deal to rent AI computing from Oracle because its older Nvidia chips no longer fit Microsoft’s specifications, Bloomberg reported. Oracle says GPUs renewed last quarter, mostly four years or older, went at a 20% premium, and IREN just recontracted older H100s at double the price.
news.title: Microsoft Dumps Oracle. Good News: Those Old Chips Renew at a “20% Premium”
news.title_zh: Microsoft 棄用 Oracle。好消息：舊晶片續約享有「20% 溢價」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：彭博社報導，Microsoft 正逐步終止一項向 Oracle 租用 AI 運算的 2023 協議，因其較舊的 Nvidia 晶片不再符合 Microsoft 規範。Oracle 表示，上季續約的 GPU 大多為四年或以上機齡，享有 20% 溢價，而 IREN 剛以雙倍價格重新簽約較舊的 H100s。

news.summary: IREN Limited is transitioning from Bitcoin mining to AI infrastructure, with rapid cloud revenue growth and a $20B contracted backlog. See why I rate IREN stock as Strong Buy.
news.title: IREN: The Market May Be Overestimating Its Funding Problem
news.title_zh: IREN：市場可能高估其資金問題
news.summary_zh: IREN Limited 正從比特幣挖礦轉型為 AI 基礎設施，雲端收入快速增長，並擁有 $20B 簽約訂單積壓。看為什麼我將 IREN 股票評為強力買入。
